subject.title: fix(discord): retry reply session init conflicts to prevent silent message loss

question: Should Discord keep this bounded channel-level retry and replay fallback as defense in depth alongside shared reply-session conflict recovery?
rationale: Both layers address the same conflict at different ownership boundaries; the patch appears safe and proven, but accepting dual-layer recovery semantics is a maintainer policy choice for message delivery and session lifecycle.

options.title: Land bounded defense in depth
options.body: Rebase and merge this Discord recovery while keeping shared session self-heal responsible for the underlying lifecycle fault.

options.title: Pause for shared recovery
options.body: Hold this PR until the shared-session proposal lands and then reassess whether Discord still needs a channel-local retry and replay fallback.
